title: Fourteen years
logline: Fourteen years. The corn on the motel's night-audit desk at 3 AM. The first strip drawn at the desk.

panels.composition: The Driftwood Motel's night-audit desk, 3 AM. A CRT. A bell. WOOD in the polo. A paper tray of corn. The pad. The ice machine's hum drawn as a flat line under the panel — the first time.

image.prompt: a motel night-audit desk at 3 AM with a CRT, a bell, a paper tray of corn and a drawing pad, a thin man in a maroon polo drawing, a low flat line drawn beneath the panel for the hum of an ice machine, muddy watercolor
image.notes: The hum line begins. It runs under every motel panel through 2027.

panels.composition: The corn. The bell. The hum line.

image.prompt: close-up of a paper tray of corn beside a desk bell on a motel counter, a flat line beneath

panels.composition: Wood, to no one — the lobby empty.

balloons.text: Fourteen years. The cafeteria is a motel lobby now. Three hundred people facing one direction was optimistic. It's one. It's me. Facing the door.

image.prompt: a man in a motel polo at a night desk talking to an empty lobby, the hum line beneath

panels.composition: The lobby from the door. Wood at the desk, small, the lamp, the corn, the CRT's glow. Facing the door. The hum.

image.prompt: a motel lobby seen from the entrance door at night, a thin man small at the lit desk facing the door, a flat hum line beneath the panel, no words
image.notes: #1's last panel: alone at a long surface. Fourteenth time.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: The first strip drawn at the motel desk. The hum line starts.
